notes.title: Full release V2.0 out now!
notes.notes:
After 8 years of early access, Cynoclept: The Game has finally reached its full release, providing absolutely NO new content! Relive the incredible moments of Nashman and his pals as they go on an perilous adventure into the human psyche, uncovering the deepest, darkest secrets of the governing body of Leeland. 

This'll be especially important as the next story in the series will be available later THIS YEAR! More news will become available over the coming months, but stay tuned for return of Nashman and co. as they fight a new, powerful entity only known as Leeton.

Here's an early image of the title screen, providing some insight into our terrifying enemy.

https://i.imgur.com/h71WWIf.jpeg
To celebrate, we're giving away 20 Cynoclept: The Game codes for you to redeem, so that you're ready and up-to-date with the story for when Cynoclept 2 drops!

notes.title: Changelog v1.0.2
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug during Level 1 that allowed players to breach out of the map.
- Fixed a bug during Level 3 that disabled players from progressing during the beginning of the level when picking up the jetpack.
- Changed the amount of lives for the player, cross-level, to 3.
- 2 new easter eggs added.
- Starting works on fixing achievement integration.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hey guys, just letting you know that there will be a Day One patch released alongside the game's release at 5pm PST on the 26th of August. So far, the reviewing for the game's official build is going smoothly and we look forward to the day you guys can get your hands on the game!

Cynoclept - Icyjolt Ent.
